steps.content: You can't pinpoint the center of this Mania field, but you do have the precise locations of the Aurum Secretum devices destroyed earlier. Their peculiar arrangement gives you an idea. You immediately extract the central coordinates and report them to Nirvana. Reinforcements finally arrives.

Almost at the same time the strike hits, a phenomenal energy erupts from inside the ship, like a coordinated pincer attack. An explosion blasts through the vessel. The region's M-value spikes to an extreme high before plummeting. More than half of the cruise liner is blown apart, and with it, goes most of the accumulated contamination.

After the Aurum Secretum devices cease functioning, the Mania field gradually settles. The sandstorm enveloping the fleet finally recedes, and regular communications are restored, confirming all squad operations were successful. A cool breeze blows through the now-open cabin, clearing your head.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Well now... Even though it was an enemy stronghold, I never imagined contamination could reach this level. You don't think they're hiding a bigger fish here, do you?

steps.speaker: Communications Officer
steps.content: The ambient M-value has returned to normal levels. Based on the Mania fluctuations recorded before the explosion, an S-Class Sinner was present at the epicenter.

steps.speaker: Communications Officer
steps.content: Another monster was also detected in the same area. We believe that the S-Class Sinner deliberately triggered the explosion. The blast eliminated the monster and incinerated the Corruptors and Apostles it had drawn in.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Oh my, did they get so scared they killed themselves before we even got a chance to fight them? That was an easy victory, Mr. ${PlayerName}.
steps.female_content: Oh my, did they get so scared they killed themselves before we even got a chance to fight them? That was an easy victory, Ms. ${PlayerName}.

steps.content: She smiles and pats your shoulder. But the Communications Officer's expression is grim.

steps.speaker: Communications Officer
steps.content: ...There's something that requires your attention.

steps.speaker: Communications Officer
steps.content: Someone's still at the center of the contamination.

You pass through long corridors and arrive at a wide, open ruin. It might have once been a dance floor, or a grand ballroom; it's hard to tell now. The blast has obliterated almost everything, leaving only melted flecks of gold dust scattered about, shimmering in the sun like a thin carpet.
This place must have been magnificent once.
Beyond the golden carpet, at the epicenter of the explosion, is a cleared, circular space that almost looks like a stage.
And at its center, something gold lies shattered on the floor.
It's a woman with golden hair. She's smiling, her eyes half-open, staring at the sky, yet blind to your approach.

The doctor holds you back. She walks forward in silence, puts on her contamination gear with practiced speed, and tries to wake the woman, to revive her... but in the end, she sighs and switches to a simple examination before returning to your side.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: ...She's an S-Class Sinner with extraordinary power. There's no doubt she's the one who leveled the place and wiped out the contamination and Corruptors. The outburst was remarkable. And fatal.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: She overused her power. That, combined with an abnormally deep contamination, has burned out her body and mind. This level of deterioration is... irreversible.
You stare, stunned. You move toward the woman on the ground, almost by instinct, and reach out a hand.
But you stop yourself. Your shackles are filled with contamination; they cannot stabilize anyone. You cannot touch her with such power. There's nothing you can do now to help her.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: There's very little we can do, Chief. It's too late...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...She won't die.
You let go of your companion's hand and move forward, step by step, until you can kneel beside her. You take her scarred hand in yours.
At her wrist, you feel a pulse. It's faint, slow, but still beating, warm and steadfast.
Her eyes, vacant and unfocused, still refuse to close, longing for one last look at the sky.
And so you look at her, and hold her hand tight.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everyone who made it out of here is strong. They fought with all their might to live.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You were the one who bought them time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Fighting the enemy alone, weakening the Mania... without you, things would've ended much worse.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rest now, have a sweet dream. And then... wake up soon.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Many people will want to meet you, to hear your name and your story. I'm one of them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...There's a whole world waiting for you. Wake up soon.
The dust settles, and birds return to the sky. The cage is finally shattered. The clouds part, and sunlight falls upon her for the first time in a long while, melting into her golden hair.
Is she celebrating victory or freedom? She closes her eyes, a smile on her face.
Like honey infused with light.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I won't die...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I still need to see... the one I love...

The investigation into corruption and infiltration crimes continues to deepen.

By an extraordinary coincidence, the patrol discovered what appears to be the largest Farland intelligence outpost deep in the high seas.
The original site of Euphoria was completely destroyed by abnormal Mania, but evidence of bribery, wiretapping, collusion, and treason has been partially recovered.
